clue.text: Might one slip one, for the record?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a spinal ... is what a person 'slips' in a back injury

explanation.walkthrough: A slipped disc is the familiar back injury; separately, a record is a disc.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the cartilage pad between vertebrae and a vinyl gramophone recording.

clue.text: It's mad, getting up to create surprise

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to say something is nuts is to call it mad

explanation.surface: Someone does something crazy purely to shock onlookers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's nuts' means it's mad; NUTS read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun someone is to astonish or surprise them greatly.

clue.text: Communist maybe, making a run?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: short for Trotskyist, a kind of communist
second meaning: a jog or slow run

explanation.walkthrough: One meaning is the informal label for a follower of Trotsky; the other is a gentle running pace.
explanation.definitionFit: A Trotskyist is informally called a Trot, and a trot is also a slow jogging pace.

clue.text: Ian with tum I massaged — it's not that big

indicators.note: massaged suggests kneading and working, so these letters are worked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Ian gets a belly rub while the speaker reassures him his tummy is not so large.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle IAN, TUM and I together; the definition is a playful description of a trivial detail.
explanation.definitionFit: A minutia is a small, trivial detail, something of little size or importance.

clue.text: Obey rules about means of escape, leading to difficulty

indicators.note: about here means going around, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: to comply is to obey the rules
an exit is a way out

explanation.surface: Following the rules on fire escapes creates bureaucratic difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obey rules' together give the verb: to comply is to follow rules; 'about' is then the containment signal, not part of that phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Complexity is intricacy, the quality that makes something hard to deal with.

clue.text: Mull wine with merit, maintaining temperature for this season

indicators.note: maintaining means holding, so the shuffled letters keep another inside them

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: to mull wine is to heat and spice it, and as an indicator it means the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A recipe: mulled wine, done well and kept warm, suits the cold months.
explanation.walkthrough: Mulled wine is a typical winter drink, which hides that 'Mull' is the signal to rearrange; WINE stays in order at the front, and the T goes in after its first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Mulled wine is associated with the cold months, so the season in question is the winter period.

clue.text: One may show off more green in France

parts.note: extra means additional, more
vert is French for green

explanation.surface: Someone flaunting a lot of greenery on holiday in France.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the less common spelling of extrovert.
explanation.definitionFit: An extravert (extrovert) is an outgoing person who tends to seek attention and display themselves.

clue.text: Modus operandi aboard satellite?

parts.note: MO is the usual abbreviation for modus operandi, a way of working
on board means on, as in on a ship

explanation.surface: Asks whether a working method is on board a spacecraft.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite, a body orbiting a planet.

clue.text: Agree court date initially, with fragments of deal?

parts.note: two things match when they agree
to court someone is to woo them

indicators.note: initially means take only the opening letter of date

parts.note: first letter of date

explanation.surface: Setting a court date for a business deal, perhaps with legal fragments involved.
explanation.walkthrough: Deal here is not a business arrangement but pine or fir timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Matchwood is wood splintered into tiny pieces, and deal is a softwood timber.

clue.text: Put up with prisoners, nearly all honest, going to court

parts.note: cons is slang for convicts

indicators.note: nearly all means drop the final letter of the word for honest

parts.note: a true person is honest

explanation.surface: Tolerating inmates who are mostly honest as they head to trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up with' looks like a phrase meaning tolerate, but 'Put up' alone is the definition, as in building something.
explanation.definitionFit: To put up a building is to erect or build it.

clue.text: Spot where a bishop works?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to spot or notice

explanation.walkthrough: A bishop's area of authority is called his see.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice something is to observe it, and a diocese governed by a bishop is called the see.

clue.text: Novice taking pawn instead of rook: that's a mistake

indicators.note: taking means the word for novice takes in a new letter
instead of marks which letter is replaced and goes out

parts.note: a tyro is a beginner
R is the chess notation for rook
P is the chess notation for pawn

explanation.surface: A chess beginner captures with a pawn rather than a rook and blunders.
explanation.walkthrough: In chess notation P is pawn and R is rook; swap them in TYRO.
explanation.definitionFit: A typo is a typing error, a small slip in printed or written text.

clue.text: Recording showing huge bird in retreat

indicators.note: in retreat means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse
showing means the letters are visible inside the word recording

parts.note: letters 3 to 5 of recording

explanation.surface: A film shows a giant bird retreating.
explanation.walkthrough: COR sits inside 'Recording'; read it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is an enormous mythical bird from Arabian legend, said to carry off elephants.

clue.text: Perhaps rib mate, making crockery?

parts.note: a rib is an example of a bone
china is Cockney rhyming slang for mate (china plate)

explanation.surface: Teasing a friend while making pottery.
explanation.walkthrough: To rib is also to tease, which hides that rib is a bone; china plate rhymes with mate in Cockney slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Bone china is a fine porcelain used for plates and cups, a type of tableware.

clue.text: Working as intended? Quite the opposite: support dismissal

definitions.text: Working as intended? Quite the opposite

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
firing is sacking, dismissal from a job

explanation.surface: A plan fails, and someone backs sacking the person responsible.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a plan that backfires produces the opposite of its intended effect.
explanation.definitionFit: When a scheme is backfiring it rebounds on its maker, producing the reverse of the intended result.

clue.text: Trawlerman's earnings, after deductions?

parts.note: a fisherman's catch comes in a net, and earnings after deductions is the accounting term for what is left

explanation.walkthrough: The accountant's phrase is read as what a fisherman hauls in with his net.
explanation.definitionFit: Income remaining after costs and tax are deducted is the accounting figure known as the bottom line.

clue.text: A-lister to go off on one — it's official

parts.note: an A-list star is a celebrity, celeb for short
to go off on one is to have an angry rant

explanation.surface: A celebrity throwing a tantrum, and it's on the record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'official' looks like an adjective (it's official!), but it is a noun: a person who officiates.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrant is the person who conducts a religious rite or ceremony, an officiant.

clue.text: Wishes to get rid of power tools

indicators.note: get rid of means the letter for power is removed

parts.note: hopes are wishes
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to dispose of their electric garden tools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'power tools' reads as one phrase, but power is split off as P.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoes are long-handled gardening implements for weeding.

clue.text: Accessory for fireplace or sink?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a coal ..., a bucket for coal by the hearth
second meaning: to ... a ship is to sink it deliberately

explanation.walkthrough: The 'or sink' looks like another household fitting, but it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A coal bucket by the hearth has this name, and holing a vessel deliberately to send it down is to scuttle it.

clue.text: Protest march: habitual response of the people

parts.note: a demo is a demonstration, a protest march
a tic is an involuntary habitual twitch

explanation.surface: Marching in protest has become the populace's reflex reaction.
explanation.definitionFit: Demotic means popular or common, relating to ordinary folk and their speech.

clue.text: Sparkly decoration is good? Rubbish!

parts.note: litter is rubbish dropped in public

explanation.surface: Someone asks if tinsel is nice and another scoffs that it is junk.
explanation.definitionFit: Glitter is tiny shiny particles used to make things sparkle in crafts and festive ornament.

clue.text: A place to grow stuff, not entirely at a great distance

indicators.note: not entirely means the word for farm loses its final letter

parts.note: a farm is where crops are grown

explanation.surface: Describes a far-off smallholding.
explanation.definitionFit: Afar means far away, at or to a remote point.

clue.text: A 1950s rocker invested in corporation at last

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, as money goes into a company

parts.note: corporation is an old jocular word for a large belly
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth subculture member associated with rock and roll

explanation.surface: An old rock-and-roller finally buys into a company.
explanation.walkthrough: Corporation looks like a business, matching 'invested', but it is the old jocular word for a pot belly. A Teddy boy was a 1950s British rock-and-roll fan.
explanation.definitionFit: Belatedly means late, after the expected time, much like finally or eventually.

clue.text: Gas, when topless, for a really long time

indicators.note: topless means the top letter of a down entry is removed

parts.note: neon is a gaseous element

explanation.surface: A joke about someone going topless and gassing on endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: An eon is an immeasurably long period, an age.

clue.text: You'll probably need this, if you're having a row

definitions.text: You'll probably need this, if you're having a row

parts.words: You'll probably need this, if you're having a row
parts.note: row read as a quarrel is a misdirection; read it as rowing a boat

explanation.walkthrough: A row sounds like an argument; the other row, propelling a boat, needs this item.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowing a boat requires a long pole with a blade, used as a lever against the water.

clue.text: Otherwise very loud German composer?

parts.note: or means otherwise, as in 'do it or else'
ff (fortissimo) is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Asks whether a German composer was extremely noisy.
explanation.walkthrough: Carl Orff composed Carmina Burana.
explanation.definitionFit: Carl Orff was a twentieth-century composer from Munich, best known for Carmina Burana.

clue.text: Change Nathan maybe, for deputy

parts.note: to alter is to change
Nate is a short form of Nathan

explanation.surface: Swapping a man called Nathan in to stand in for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: An alternate is a substitute or stand-in, someone who acts in another's place.

clue.text: Went on horseback in such a way, it could be said

indicators.note: it could be said means the word is spoken, giving one that sounds the same

parts.note: a road is a way

explanation.surface: Describes someone riding along in a particular manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Rode is the past tense of ride, as in travelling on a horse.

clue.text: Jelly in a cloth served up

indicators.note: served up in a down clue means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: a rag is a piece of cloth

explanation.surface: A dessert of jelly arriving wrapped in a napkin.
explanation.definitionFit: Agar is a gelatinous substance derived from seaweed, used as a setting agent.

clue.text: Looks at first of elephants? Affirmative

indicators.note: first of means take only the opening letter of elephants

parts.note: first letter of elephants
yes is an affirmative answer

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether a person has looked at the elephants and gets a yes.
explanation.definitionFit: To eye something is to watch it, so the verb form matches gazing at or observing.

clue.text: One not being fired, losing will at last

indicators.note: losing means a letter drops out of the word for not fired

parts.note: something not set alight is unlit

indicators.note: at last means take the final letter of will

parts.note: last letter of will

explanation.surface: A worker kept on despite losing his will to carry on.
explanation.walkthrough: Fired is set alight, not sacked; UNLIT loses L.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit is a single thing, a quantity of one.

clue.text: Get first of trophies in exotic tree award and progress no further

indicators.note: first of means take only the opening letter of trophies

parts.note: first letter of trophies

indicators.note: exotic means strange and foreign, so these letters are made strange by rearrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Winning prizes for unusual trees, but getting nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get' and 'in' are just link words; the T goes in front of the scrambled TREE AWARD letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To tread water is to stay afloat in one spot, hence figuratively to make no headway.
